description: This file defines the SnapshotAdapter interface used for transforming snapshots between domain models and database representations in an Akka persistence context. It provides methods for converting domain snapshots to storage objects and vice versa, for handling both SnapshotOffer and SelectedSnapshot types.

classes.name: SnapshotAdapter
classes.description: A generic interface for adapting Akka persistence snapshots to custom storage formats and vice versa, supporting conversion for both snapshots loaded from snapshots and selected snapshots.

methods.name: toSnapshotStore
methods.description: Transform a domain snapshot object into a database-compatible object for persistence.

methods.name: fromSnapshotStore (SnapshotOffer)
methods.description: Converts a database snapshot loaded via SnapshotOffer into a domain snapshot object.

methods.name: fromSnapshotStore (SelectedSnapshot)
methods.description: Converts a database snapshot loaded via SelectedSnapshot into a domain snapshot object.
